evidence.notes: An explicit Object record with allOrNone=false returns a successful SaveResult and persists the Account.
An explicit Object record with allOrNone=false returns a successful SaveResult and persists the updated Account.
An explicit Object record with allOrNone=false and AccessLevel returns a successful SaveResult and persists the updated Account.

source.content: Object insertedObject = new Account(Name = 'Boolean Insert'); Database.SaveResult inserted = Database.insert(insertedObject, false); System.assert(inserted.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(1, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name = 'Boolean Insert']); Object updatedObject = new Account(Id = inserted.getId(), Name = 'Boolean Updated'); Database.SaveResult updated = Database.update(updatedObject, false); System.assert(updated.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(1, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name = 'Boolean Updated']); Object accessUpdatedObject = new Account(Id = inserted.getId(), Name = 'Boolean Access Updated'); Database.SaveResult accessUpdated = Database.update(accessUpdatedObject, false, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assert(accessUpdated.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(1, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name = 'Boolean Access Updated']);
